permissionModes.label: Default
permissionModes.description: Asks in the chat about each action that needs permission

permissionModes.label: Accept edits
permissionModes.description: Edits files without asking; asks about commands that need permission

permissionModes.label: Auto
permissionModes.description: The agent decides which actions to ask about; where the account has no such mode it asks as Default does

permissionModes.label: Don't ask
permissionModes.description: Refuses any action that needs permission, without asking

permissionModes.label: Read only
permissionModes.description: Reads only; edits no files and runs no command that writes

permissionModes.label: Workspace write
permissionModes.description: Edits files and runs commands inside the working folder

permissionModes.label: Full access
permissionModes.description: Runs every action without asking, with no folder off limits
